function.name: check_warranty_registration
function.description: Check the NFC paddle warranty registration status for a given order. Returns whether the paddle was registered, the registration date, whether registration happened inside the 14-day window from purchase, and whether the receipt was approved. Call this only after lookup_order has succeeded and the product is an NFC-capable paddle, OR when the customer explicitly claims they registered their paddle. Provide order_id (preferred) or nfc_id.

order_id.description: The internal order UUID returned by lookup_order. Preferred.

order_number.description: Order number as fallback if order_id is not available.

nfc_id.description: The NFC chip ID printed on the paddle. Use when the customer gives it directly and no order is known.
